episodes.title: Part 1
episodes.summary: Persephone weds the feared Duke of Kielder to save her family, but his cold distance threatens their future.

episodes.title: Part 2
episodes.summary: As tragedy strikes and duty separates them, Persephone and Adam discover their growing attachment.

episodes.title: Part 3
episodes.summary: Adam tries to make Falstone home, but Persephone still can't break through his guarded heart.

episodes.title: Part 4
episodes.summary: After a terrible riding accident, Adam must choose between holding Persephone-or setting her free.
